x86_64.notes: Full shinchiro winbuild (filters enabled). Not the media_kit slim audio build.

universal.notes: Prefer audio-full over media_kit's audio-default. fetch_full_libmpv.sh lifts the versioned wrapper so xcframeworks sit at macos/universal/*.xcframework.

linux.notes: Prefer distro full libmpv (filters present). Optional: place libmpv.so* under third_party/libmpv/linux/x86_64 for bundling.
